stem.text: Which row is correct for neutrophils and B-lymphocytes?

A.text: can change shape; activated by contact with antigens

B.text: found in organs rather than in blood; kill virus-infected cells

C.text: may be long-lived cells; always short-lived cells

D.text: their lysosomal enzymes digest bacteria; secrete cytokines

B: found in organs rather than in blood
